meta.title: Per-line-item sections each get their own item template
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event with an RFP technical stage.
Work on the technical stage where the item sections are shown.
Apply the stage template required before adding line items.
Create the two line items required for two separate item sections.

args.goal: On the RFP Technical Stage questionnaire screen, set a non-default item template on each of the two line-item sections, fill or reveal their questions as needed, and stop only when both sections visibly show their selected template name and their questions.

steps.note: Perform and verify the per-line-item template selection and question rendering.
Confirm the completed questionnaire screen has no application error.
